name: Caudiel (Spain)
description: A hoist third of four red pales on yellow within a white bordure charged with eight small shields, the fly red with a yellow tower between two green laurel branches.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 27 January 2009 of the vicepresident primer and conseller de Presidència, published in the Diari Oficial de la Comunitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3 tierced at the hoist, the first third with four pales of gules on or within a bordure of argent charged with eight shields of or and a fess of azure, taken from the arms approved on 17 January 2005.

features.role: four red pales on yellow within a white bordure of eight shields
